assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: The fixture stops creating a real Git conflict; merge-tree is the independent positive control for reaching the queue conflict path.
The queue lands the discarded conflicting delivery, omits its obligation, or labels a different guard; reverting receipt advice also raises before these assertions.
The queue fails to persist a refused admission or loses the discarded semantic remedy; this is a fixed semantic expectation, not a supplied expected receipt.

Reverting to the short settled receipt removes required keys; a non-refused persisted status or divergent queue remedy also fails. The advice/remedy equality checks two persisted outputs and is supplemented by the independent discarded check at :213; it is not an input compared with its own echo.
Any worker resume is attempted for the discarded delivery, as observed by the fixture spy.
Worktree release occurs before removing the matching pointer, so the callback sees the pointer still on disk.
A remote-settled delivery keeps its stale pending record or resumes a worker instead of settling.
Cleanup deletes or rewrites the newer attempt, or offers its worktree for release. The expected bytes come from the file before the call, independently of the code's output.
Restoring the early return leaves the original marked pointer or skips release; using the delivered head instead of the remote integration tip also fails the Git-derived expected release arguments.

failure_evidence.derivation: Read completed run baseline_suite and after_suite logs, checked revision and terminal EXIT, and subtracted their FAILED IDs: both empty. Parser positive control found the one known failure in each importer log, identically.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read source manifest.md and captured gate logs; the 51-pass baseline, 67-pass repaired head, unchanged importer failure and three coordinator reconciliation actions are recorded consistently.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read source prompt.txt:80-85 and manifest.md; all four incremental changed paths are granted, with no live pending-record mutation in the diff.
